notes:
Overview: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary contact: Priya Rao (Head of Product). Team evaluating Redwood for doc search + in-app support assistant. Roadmap: start on Hosted API for fast iteration, move to Dedicated (VPC) for production by H1 2025.

Recent timeline:
- 2024-11-02: Intro email from Maya; Priya replied interested in quick PoC.
- 2024-11-15: Demo (hosted API): showed embeddings + chat pipeline. Fireflies ff-20241115-3427.
- 2024-11-22: PoC kickoff (hosted) — ingest 120k docs, vector index, basic reranking. Fireflies ff-20241122-8810.
- 2024-11-29: PoC results: embedding recall ~0.82 on internal eval set; response UX acceptable. Team requested throughput/cost estimates for 100k queries/day.
- 2024-12-01: Pricing conversation with finance; initial ARR target $100k-$150k.
- 2024-12-03: Customer requested Dedicated/VPC for production due to customer data residency and audit needs.
- 2024-12-05: Security questionnaire submitted from their security team; asked for SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML integration details, audit log retention SLAs, KMS/HSM options, and data residency guarantees.

Use-case & requirements (shorthand):
- Workloads: doc_search (embeddings + reranking), in-app support chat (chat completions + tool calls), nightly index rebuilds.
- Latency targets: chat p95 <= 200ms (interactive), embedding response <= 150ms for single doc vectors (bulk embedding jobs acceptable to be longer).
- Throughput: steady-state ~30 qps for search APIs during business hours; spike tolerance to 100 qps for marketing events.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market — wants clear unit economics; finance wants cost per 1M tokens and per-embedding cost scenarios for reserved vs hosted.
- Model preferences: open-models acceptable; preference for quantized/x86-optimized variants for Dedicated to reduce cost. Must support model pinning and predictable rollouts.

Security / compliance notes (from security team):
- "We cannot accept PII leaving our VPC for production workloads." -- Priya Rao
- SOC2 Type II report mandatory before procurement.
- SSO: require SAML 2.0 IdP (Okta). Need SCIM for user provisioning.
- Audit logs: need immutable audit trail for user actions + inference requests metadata retained 12 months by default.
- Retention controls: ability to configure token/log retention per-environment; legal needs 30/90/365 day presets.
- KMS: want bring-your-own-key (BYOK) or HSM-backed option for model encryption and storage keys.
- Data residency: EU customers must be served from eu-1 region; some EU contracts mandate no cross-border replication.

POC notes / technical tidbits:
- PoC ran on hosted; dev team used streaming for chat, embeddings batched nightly.
- Asked about prefix/KV cache to lower token cost for multi-turn support chat. SE notes: can enable prefix cache + aggressive batching in Dedicated.
- Asked for a canary strategy for model rollouts (A/B). Interested in Redwood's automatic fallback policies when capacity constrained.

- Send SOC2 Type II PDF + VPC network diagram (Maya) — target 2024-12-06.
- Share SAML/SCIM integration guide and sample metadata (Ethan) — target 2024-12-08.
- Setup security review call (infra + legal) wk of 2024-12-11.
- Finance to review final pricing for Dedicated commitment (Priya -> CFO).

- Timeline for SAML + SCIM setup in Dedicated onboarding.
- Clarify BYOK flow and key rotation frequency.
